title: cardamine maritima subsp. maglicensis
intro: Cardamine maritima subsp. maglicensis, commonly known as Balkan spring cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine maritima subsp. maglicensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
